scope: Every bibliography entry: existence, author order and name rendering, title, publication year, venue or source type, volume, pages or article number where applicable, and persistent link. Citation relevance was checked against primary abstracts, book descriptions, dataset descriptions, and full-text passages for detailed claims. Capitalization and punctuation follow the manuscript style.
